mapper.select: SELECT ca.target_id AS familyId, f.name AS familyName, f.cover_image AS familyCoverImage, m.alias AS alias, ca.source_circle_id AS sourceCircleId, ca.created_at AS createdAt FROM content_audience ca JOIN sys_family_info f ON f.id = ca.target_id AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN family_circle_member m ON m.circle_id = ca.source_circle_id AND m.family_id = ca.target_id WHERE ca.content_type = #{contentType} AND ca.content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY ca.id

SELECT ca.content_id AS contentId, ca.owner_family_id AS familyId, f.name AS familyName, f.cover_image AS familyCoverImage, m.alias AS alias FROM content_audience ca JOIN sys_family_info f ON f.id = ca.owner_family_id AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN family_circle_member m ON m.circle_id = ca.source_circle_id AND m.family_id = ca.owner_family_id WHERE ca.content_type = #{contentType} AND ca.target_type = 'FAMILY' AND ca.target_id = #{targetId} AND ca.content_id IN #{id}

SELECT ca.id AS id, ca.content_type AS contentType, ca.content_id AS contentId, ca.target_id AS targetFamilyId, f.name AS targetFamilyName, ca.source_circle_id AS sourceCircleId, c.name AS circleName, ca.created_at AS createdAt FROM content_audience ca LEFT JOIN sys_family_info f ON f.id = ca.target_id LEFT JOIN family_circle c ON c.id = ca.source_circle_id WHERE ca.owner_family_id = #{ownerFamilyId} ORDER BY ca.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_audience WHERE owner_family_id = #{ownerFamilyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_audience WHERE owner_family_id = #{ownerFamilyId}
